title: OM SponsoredMailboxGrant logical schema
description: Bounded, revocable starter mailbox a Home grants to a newly invited account (ADR-0102). Grants mailbox capacity only: no identity, control, discovery or content authority.

grant_id.description: Random opaque id; never derived from AccountID.

sponsor_home_ref.description: Opaque provider locator of the sponsoring Home; not an AccountID.

deposit_capability_ref.description: Opaque scoped deposit capability handle (normal RelaySet entry).

drain_capability_ref.description: Opaque scoped drain capability handle held only by the sponsored account's devices.

expires_at.description: Provider wall-clock seconds; clock class provider_wallclock_non_authoritative (TIME_AND_EXPIRY_SEMANTICS.md).

may_sponsor_further.description: Baseline sponsorship cannot be chained; T1 hosted Homes use their own policy instead.
